definitions.gloss: call charges, telephone charges, phone bill
definitions.explanation: The fee charged for making telephone calls, whether landline or mobile.

examples.japanese: {通話料|つうわりょう}が{高|たか}い。
{国際|こくさい}{通話料|つうわりょう}は{国内|こくない}より{高|たか}くなる。
examples.english: International call charges are higher than domestic ones.

examples.japanese: このプランなら{通話料|つうわりょう}{無料|むりょう}で{何時間|なんじかん}でも{話|はな}せます。
examples.english: With this plan, you can talk for as long as you want with no call charges.

notes:
{通話料|つうわりょう} is composed of {通話|つうわ} (telephone call) + {料|りょう} (fee, charge).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通話料|つうわりょう}{無料|むりょう}: free calls, no call charges
- {通話料|つうわりょう}{込|こ}み: call charges included
- {国際|こくさい}{通話料|つうわりょう}: international calling rates
- {通話料|つうわりょう}がかかる: call charges apply

RELATED WORDS:
- {通信料|つうしんりょう}: data charges (for internet)
- {基本料|きほんりょう}: basic fee (monthly plan cost)
